subject: Azaelle / Azåelle / Azael
scope: Raw aura breakdowns available locally, deduplicated to distinct runs

method.ragefireAverage: Ragefire total damage divided by Ragefire impact count
method.auraAverage: Immolation Aura composite total divided by all Aura and Ragefire impacts
method.directAuraAverage: Direct Immolation Aura subentries only, excluding Ragefire
method.deduplication: Identical report snapshots with the same date, dungeon, key, stats and impact counts collapsed to one run
method.limitation: The broader 52-snapshot index does not contain raw Ragefire and direct-Aura subentries for every snapshot.

murderRowPlus15ToPlus16.note: Not a clean stat-scaling measurement: Crit changes by +1, Mastery by -40 and Versatility by +62, while key, route, pulls, buffs and deaths also differ.

interpretation.conclusion: No monotonic progression attributable to stats is established. With nearly identical stats, dungeon and pull context changes Ragefire average impact by about 37% and composite Aura average by about 19%.
